POSTGRES_USER.description: Postgres superuser name. Paperless-ngx connects with these credentials.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Postgres password. Default literal 'paperless' so a fresh template deploy authenticates out of the box. Rotate this in the dashboard before production.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial database created on first boot. Must match PAPERLESS_DBNAME on the Paperless service.

PGDATA.description: Postgres data directory. Must be a subdirectory of the volume mount path (/var/lib/postgresql) so lost+found stays outside PGDATA.
